facts.claim: Three schools were established at Vfrdjpet, Kiggatndd and Fraserpet with a total of 245 pupils.
facts.quote: established at Vfrdjpet, Kiggatndd and Fraserpet with a total of 245 pupils are to serve a double purpose.

facts.claim: Two more schools were opened at Padyndlkandd and Kodlipet, giving each taluq an English School.
facts.quote: With the opening of two more Schools at Padyndlkandd and Kodlipet, each taluq will have an English School.

facts.claim: The Central School at Mercara advanced to its present position after a decisive step in 1862 when Coorg Headmen petitioned the Government for assistance.
facts.quote: The Central School at Mercara gradually advanced to its present position, the first decisive step having been taken in 1862, when the Coorg Headmen petitioned Government for assistance.
